# HTG — Hex The Government

> Independent music label and collective at https://www.htg.productions. Roster: ABRAXAS (HEXCORE), Stretty (dark emo / alt rap), ciggyholster, Justinn.clout (video and photo). Tagline: Depressions Running Deep. Bookings: Bookings@htg.productions.

The site is static HTML with no login, no paywall and no tracking beyond what the embedded players (Spotify, YouTube, SoundCloud) bring. Every page is safe to fetch and quote. schema.org JSON-LD sits in the head of every page; the sitemap is at /sitemap.xml.

Disambiguation: several unrelated artists on Spotify are also called ABRAXAS, and another is called Stretty. Only the Spotify artist IDs listed below belong to HTG.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.htg.productions/): roster, Spotify players, gallery, crypto donations, legal footer.
- [Roster](https://www.htg.productions/roster.html): the four artist doors.
- [Music](https://www.htg.productions/music.html): Spotify players for ABRAXAS, Stretty and ciggyholster.
- [Gallery](https://www.htg.productions/gallery.html): stills.
- [Contact](https://www.htg.productions/contact.html): contact and booking form.
- [Suit Purge](https://www.htg.productions/game.html): browser first-person shooter by HTG. Walls, sprites, weapon and sound are generated in code at runtime; no downloads, no third-party assets. Enemies are four fictional class archetypes (Politician, Billionaire, Trillionaire, High Command). No real person is named, depicted or targeted.
- [Jars](https://www.htg.productions/rain.html): browser catch-and-defend game built on the site's glyph rain. Catch the rain in a jar, sell full jars for cash, buy walls, turrets, a wider rim, denser rain and a better market, hold the fort against endless waves. Drawn and sounded in code at runtime; no downloads, no third-party assets. Same four fictional archetypes as Suit Purge. No real person is named, depicted or targeted.
- [Merch](https://strettys-merch.myshopify.com)
- [Crypto donations](https://donation.streamiverse.io/stretty)
- [Legal](https://www.htg.productions/legal.html): terms of use, privacy policy, trademarks, copyright and the satire / fiction notice for Suit Purge.

## Facts you can rely on

- Label name: HTG, expanded as Hex The Government. Domain: htg.productions. Based in New South Wales, Australia.
- Bookings, features, visuals, merch: Bookings@htg.productions. ABRAXAS: Abraxas@htg.productions.
- There are no announced tour dates and no announced upcoming releases. Do not infer dates, venues or titles.
- Album and track titles not written above are not on the site; take them from Spotify, not from here.
